title: AI Profile Picture Generator
summary: Free AI profile picture generator: turn a photo into a professional headshot, anime, 3D cartoon, pixel art or watercolour PFP, or draw an original character.
body_markdown:
### Is there a free AI profile picture generator?


Yes. Flick is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6, which made every profile picture on this page, costs 5 credits an image.


### How do I make an AI profile picture from my photo?


Add a clear photo of yourself as a reference image, describe the style and background you want, and ask the model to keep your face, hair and any glasses or jewellery exactly the same.


### What are the best styles for a profile picture?


The most popular profile picture styles are clean professional headshots, anime, 3D cartoon characters, pixel art avatars for gaming, watercolour or painted portraits, comic book ink, black and white studio portraits and warm film photo portraits.


### Can I make a profile picture of an original character?


Yes. Describe the character's face, hair, one or two marks such as a scar, the clothes and the background, and ask for a centred head and shoulders; no photo is needed.


### What size should a profile picture be?


Most apps show a profile picture as a small circle, so keep the face large and centred with space around it and a plain background, and check that it still reads at the size of a chat avatar.


### Can I make a professional headshot for LinkedIn with AI?


Yes. Ask for a head and shoulders portrait with a level gaze, a plain neutral background, soft even light and work clothes, and keep your face exactly as it is so it matches you in person.


### Can I make an animated profile picture?


Yes. Use the finished profile picture as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe one small movement, such as a blink and a wider smile, and ask it to keep the style exactly as drawn.
